left.pt-BR: Nuna corre, corre, corre. Muito barulho!
left.en: Nuna runs, runs, runs. So much noise!

right.pt-BR: O macaco pula, pula. Faz barulho também.
right.en: The monkey jumps, jumps. Makes noise too.
right.es-MX: El mono salta, salta. Hace ruido también.

spreads.scene: A child in a forest clearing, running with arms wide. A monkey in a tree, jumping with arms wide. Forest floor with some leaves, dense green foliage, bright sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna para. Que bom. Tudo quieto.
left.en: Nuna stops. How nice. All quiet.
left.es-MX: Nuna se detiene. Qué bien. Todo callado.

right.pt-BR: A preguiça para. Não faz nada.
right.es-MX: La pereza se detiene. No hace nada.

spreads.scene: A child stands still, looking up with a gentle smile. A sloth hangs motionless from a branch. Forest floor with roots, dense green canopy, soft blue sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna deita na grama. Olha para cima.
left.en: Nuna lies on the grass. Looks up.
left.es-MX: Nuna se acuesta en la hierba. Mira hacia arriba.

right.pt-BR: O camaleão deita no galho. Olha. Espera.
right.en: The chameleon lies on the branch. Looks. Waits.
right.es-MX: El camaleón se acuesta en la rama. Mira. Espera.

spreads.scene: A child lying on green grass, looking up. A chameleon lying flat on a tree branch, looking up. Green grass, tree trunk and branches, bright blue sky.

left.es-MX: Nuna se esconde. Muy calladita aquí.

right.pt-BR: A coruja se esconde. Ninguém a vê.
right.en: The owl hides. No one sees it.
right.es-MX: La lechuza se esconde. Nadie la ve.

spreads.scene: A child peeking from behind a large bush. An owl camouflaged behind leaves on a tree branch. Bush and forest floor, dense foliage, dappled light on the sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna respira devagar. Um passarinho canta.
left.en: Nuna breathes slowly. A little bird sings.
left.es-MX: Nuna respira despacio. Un pajarito canta.

right.pt-BR: O cervo respira. Não faz barulho.
right.en: The deer breathes. Makes no sound.
right.es-MX: El venado respira. No hace ruido.

spreads.scene: A child sitting cross-legged, eyes closed, calm expression. A deer standing still in a clearing, head slightly bowed. Forest floor with fallen leaves, tall trees, soft sunlight.

left.pt-BR: Nuna olha a formiga. Que pequena!
left.en: Nuna looks at the ant. So tiny!

right.pt-BR: A preguiça olha a joaninha. Devagarinho.
right.en: The sloth looks at the ladybug. Very slowly.
right.es-MX: La pereza mira la mariquita. Muy despacio.

spreads.scene: A child kneeling on the ground, head close to the earth, observing something small. A sloth hanging low, head tilted, observing something tiny on a leaf. Ground with small plants, tree roots, soft light filtering through leaves.

left.pt-BR: Nuna senta na pedra. Escuta o riacho.
left.en: Nuna sits on a rock. Hears the stream.
left.es-MX: Nuna se sienta en la roca. Escucha el arroyo.

right.pt-BR: O camaleão senta no galho. Escuta.
right.en: The chameleon sits on the branch. Listens.
right.es-MX: El camaleón se sienta en la rama. Escucha.

spreads.scene: A child sitting on a large smooth rock beside a small stream, head slightly tilted. A chameleon perched on a branch overlooking a small puddle, head slightly tilted. Rocky ground, flowing water, dense forest foliage, bright sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna vê uma borboleta. Ela voa leve.
left.en: Nuna sees a butterfly. It flies lightly.
left.es-MX: Nuna ve una mariposa. Ella vuela ligera.

right.pt-BR: A coruja vê um vaga-lume. Voa na noite.
right.en: The owl sees a firefly. Flies in the night.
right.es-MX: La lechuza ve una luciérnaga. Vuela en la noche.

spreads.scene: A child standing still, pointing gently at a butterfly in the air. An owl perched on a branch, looking intently at a firefly glowing in the dark. Forest floor, tall trees with dark silhouettes, starry night sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna encontra um cogumelo. Que lindo!
left.en: Nuna finds a mushroom. So pretty!

right.pt-BR: O cervo encontra a flor. Ele cheira.
right.en: The deer finds a flower. It smells it.
right.es-MX: El venado encuentra la flor. La huele.

spreads.scene: A child kneeling, gently touching a mushroom on the forest floor. A deer bending its head to sniff a small flower. Leafy forest floor, tree trunks, dappled sunlight.

left.pt-BR: Nuna fica parada. O passarinho pousa.
left.en: Nuna stands still. The bird lands.
left.es-MX: Nuna se queda quieta. El pajarito aterriza.

right.pt-BR: A preguiça fica quieta. O pássaro pousa.
right.en: The sloth stays quiet. The bird lands.
right.es-MX: La pereza se queda quieta. El pájaro aterriza.

spreads.scene: A child standing very still, a small bird perched on her outstretched finger. A sloth hanging motionless, a small bird perched on its head. Forest floor, dense foliage, bright sky.

left.pt-BR: Nuna sente o vento. O mundo fala baixo.
left.en: Nuna feels the wind. The world speaks softly.
left.es-MX: Nuna siente el viento. El mundo habla bajo.

right.pt-BR: O cervo sente o vento. Escuta a floresta.
right.en: The deer feels the wind. Listens to the forest.
right.es-MX: El venado siente el viento. Escucha el bosque.

spreads.scene: A child standing on a gentle hillside, eyes closed, face tilted up, feeling the wind. A deer standing alert in a field, ears perked, feeling the wind. Grassy hillside, distant trees, open sky with soft clouds.

left.pt-BR: Nuna agora sabe. O silêncio é amigo.
left.en: Nuna now knows. Silence is a friend.
left.es-MX: Nuna ahora sabe. El silencio es amigo.

right.pt-BR: A coruja agora sabe. O silêncio traz.
right.en: The owl now knows. Silence brings.
right.es-MX: La lechuza ahora sabe. El silencio trae.

spreads.scene: A child sitting peacefully under a tree, a small smile on her face, eyes open. An owl perched calmly on a branch, looking out with serene eyes. Tree roots and leaves on the ground, large tree trunk, soft light filtering through leaves.
